checklist.value: pack updated within 5 business days of each closure so it never lags the GRC register

testing.value: no finding closed in GRC >5 business days ago missing from the pack

checklist.step: Remediations that change architecture backed by ADRs
checklist.value: findings resolved via design change reference the accepted ADR in the pack entry

testing.value: design-related closures each cite an ADR, else flagged

checklist.step: Automated compliance checks evidence remediation
checklist.value: where a finding was a control gap, the re-run of the arch/security check is attached as closure evidence

testing.value: control-gap closures include a passing automated-check run link

checklist.step: Remediation evidence retained on the cybersecurity audit trail
checklist.value: security-finding closure evidence kept min 3 years in the evidence repository

testing.value: sampled security-finding evidence shows retention >= 3 years and hash integrity

checklist.step: Incident-driven remediations reflect the tested IR plan
checklist.value: findings from incident post-mortems close with evidence tying back to IR-plan action items

testing.step: Trace incident findings to IR closure
testing.value: each incident-sourced finding has remediation evidence in the pack, else re-opened
